title: FROM a locally built image tries to pull from docker.io when the buildx builder uses the docker-container driver
symptoms: load metadata for docker.io/library/my_base_image:latest fails although docker images lists my_base_image
pull access denied, repository does not exist or may require authorization
cause: A docker-container builder runs BuildKit inside its own container with its own content store, so it cannot read images from the engine's image store and resolves the name against a registry instead.
fix: Build images that depend on local images with the default docker builder, push the base image to a registry first, or switch to the containerd image store. Check which builder is active with docker buildx ls.
apply:
docker buildx use default
docker buildx build -t my_base_image .
docker buildx build -f final.dockerfile --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=my_base_image .
affected: Docker Buildx with docker-container, kubernetes, or remote drivers (common after docker buildx create --use or in CI with setup-buildx-action), as of October 2026
